newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hardie says finance director to retire.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hardie says finance director to retire.

text.p: Building materials manufacturer James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Friday that financial director John MacFadden will retire from that position and the board on February 28 as a result of a management restructuring.
Phillip Morley has been appointed Chief Financial Officer effective March 1.
Morley has been executive general manager of the building services division for the past two years.
The company also announced the appointment of John Moller as executive general manager of the building systems division, effective immediately.

"In this new role, Mr Moller will be responsible for developing the company's expanding and strategically important Building Systems business which offers high level synergy with fibre cement operations," Hardie said.
The company said the management restructing follows the sale of the sale of the company's building services and irrigation businesses in December 1996.
